name: Forced displacement
summary: No new event displacing 500,000 people; Murasu evacuations about 10,000
state: No single new event displacing more than 500,000 people in a month had been found as of 3 Nov. About 10,000 people were evacuated ahead of Cyclone Murasu's landfall on 3 Nov (NationPath), and UNHCR counts 1.25 million Congolese refugees and asylum seekers (allAfrica, 2 Nov).
